item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Cherry Studio 2.2.3
item.description:
Customize your own AI assistant

Cherry Studio is a Windows, Mac, and Linux-compatible desktop client that supports multiple major language model (LLM) providers. It not only integrates cloud services such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, but also supports the deployment of Ollama and LM Studio native models. Users can use the built-in 300 + preconfigured AI assistants, or custom create a dedicated assistant to talk to multiple models at the same time and get diverse perspectives. At the same time, the app supports a variety of document formats, including text, pictures, Office, and PDF, with WebDAV file management and data backup capabilities. Cherry Studio also provides useful tools such as global search, topic management, AI-driven translation, and ensures a quality experience with light and dark themes and transparent windows that can be used out of the box without additional configuration. Users who like Cherry Studio can support its development through Little Star or sponsored developers.

item.title: MiaoYan 4.11.0
item.description:
macOS Native Markdown Editor

MiaoYan is a lightweight Markdown laptop app designed to help users easily write beautiful sentences. It features purely local use for security while supporting features such as syntax highlighting, dark mode, and automatic document layout. Users can enjoy a minimalistic three-column design that includes folders, file lists, and an editor for a great visual experience. MiaoYan uses Swift5 for native development, outperforms traditional web applications, and provides a number of shortcuts to improve editing efficiency. Other features include document export, internal jumps, graph bed support, and support for LaTeX, Mermaid, PlantUML, and Markmap brainstorming, making it a versatile writing tool.

item.title: WallpaperMachine 1.14.0
item.description:
Native Dynamic Wallpaper Tool for macOS

WallpaperMachine is a native live wallpaper app for Macs with Apple silicon. It can run Wallpaper Engine's scene wallpapers, video wallpapers, and web wallpapers on macOS 15 Sequoia and later versions. The app features built-in browsing and downloading from the Steam Workshop, allowing you to browse a vast amount of content without logging in. To download, you need a Steam account with Wallpaper Engine. For scene wallpapers, you also need to purchase the shared resources separately during installation. The interface is divided into three tabs: Discover, Installed, and Settings. After selecting a wallpaper, press Play to apply it to the desktop. Each monitor can have its wallpaper set independently or mirrored from another monitor, and zoom, frame rate, and volume can be configured separately. After enabling audio response, wallpapers designed for sound will move in sync with the content currently playing on the Mac. Media integration allows wallpapers with music displays to show the song that is currently playing. When running on battery power, you can choose to keep running, reduce the load according to the custom rendering scale and frame rate, or pause directly. Videos and scene wallpapers can also be used experimentally for lock screen animations.

item.title: Bing Wallpaper 2.0.30.0
item.description:
macOS free wallpaper app

The Bing Wallpaper app lets you explore the world through a single image every day. Downloading this app will bring your desktop to life every day with beautiful images from around the world that have been featured on the background of Bing's homepage. This not only allows you to see different landscapes in front of your computer every day, but also allows you to browse through these pictures and learn where they come from, allowing you to gain insight and experience different cultures and nature while using your computer on a daily basis. Bring new life to your desktop every day by downloading Bing Wallpaper. Bing Wallpaper offers a selection of beautiful images from around the world that were featured on Bing's homepage. Not only will you see a new image on your desktop every day, but you'll also be able to browse through the images and learn where they came from. Discover a new place every day to bring your desktop to life.

item.title: FluxMarkdown 1.58.899
item.description:
Markdown Quick Preview QuickLook Extension

FluxMarkdown is a Markdown quick preview tool for macOS, designed for Finder's QuickLook scene, which allows you to view the content of a document instantly by pressing a space, without having to open the editor first. It can not only render common Markdown, but also supports Mermaid charts, KaTeX mathematical formulas, GitHub Flavored Markdown, directory panels, code highlighting, and a variety of chart syntaxes. It is suitable for programmers, technical writers, and document organizers to quickly confirm the layout and content structure when browsing files. The software also provides PDF and HTML export, scaling and panning, scrolling position memory, light and dark color, and system theme switching, and can adjust the rendering and editing experience through the settings window, and has high compatibility with a variety of Markdown-related extensions.

item.title: Hidden Bar 1.13.2
item.description:
Menu Bar Icon Hiding Tool

Hidden Bar is a tool for hiding macOS menu bar icons. How to use: Hold down the `⌘ Command` key in the menu bar, and two icons will appear, "｜" and ">". Then, drag the icon you want to collapse to the left of the "｜" icon. Click the ">" arrow icon to expand/collapse the menu bar icons. However, pay attention to a logical issue: the ">" icon cannot be placed to the left of the "｜" icon, as it cannot fold itself in.

item.title: Ghost Downloader 4.5.11
item.description:
Cross-platform, open-source, multi-threaded downloader

Ghost Downloader 3 is an open-source, cross-platform, multi-protocol download manager for macOS 13.0 and later. It is built using Python, Qt, and a Fluent Design-style interface and can run on Intel x86_64 and Apple Silicon arm64 devices. The software offers an IDM-like intelligent segmented download mechanism, eliminating the need for additional file merging after task completion, and incorporates AI-driven intelligent acceleration to enhance transfer efficiency. Supports resource types such as HTTP, magnet links, BT, FTP, M3U8, MPEG-DASH, and eD2k. It can also simulate the TLS fingerprints of real browsers, reducing the likelihood of download requests being blocked by anti-scraping mechanisms. With built-in YouTube and Bilibili video parsing capabilities, it can handle playlists, videos up to 4K HDR, subtitles, and login content, and provides dedicated parsing and mirror acceleration for GitHub Releases and Hugging Face models.

item.title: Notchi 0.9.41
item.description:
macOS Notch Smart Assistant

Notchi is a native macOS tool that transforms the Mac notch area into a shortcut for input and an intelligent task portal. Users simply move their mouse near the notch and enter natural language to jot down ideas, create time-based reminders, ask AI questions, or invoke a coding agent to handle project tasks. The software can recognize input intent, store ordinary content in memos, directly convert sentences like "Call Mom tomorrow at 9:00 a.m." into system reminders, and support online searches, source citations, clipboard screenshot recognition, and precise mathematical calculations. For development tasks, users can specify a project folder and describe their requirements, which are then executed in the background by the native Codex or Claude CLI. Even after the notch is closed, the current step and time elapsed are still displayed, and a system notification is sent when the task is completed. Notchi uses a Liquid Glass material that harmonizes with the macOS style, seamlessly integrating the panel and screen bezel through background blur, edge lighting, and fluid animations. The classification of the input is completed locally. The issue will be sent directly to the corresponding platform using the service provider key selected by the user, without passing through the developer's server.

item.title: Guitar Wiz 2.6.1
item.description:
macOS all-round guitar practice learning artifact

Guitar Wiz: Chords & Tuner is an all-in-one guitar companion app for Mac, iPad, and iPhone that combines mass and string libraries, real-time tuners, metronomes, chord aids, songwriting tools, and sheet music scanning. The application provides interactive chord graphs to support quick search by name, note or virtual fingerboard. Each chord is accompanied by finger suggestions, high-quality audio samples, and theoretical analysis of music to help users deepen their understanding of pitch, indexing, and common scenarios. The Chord Assist function uses the device microphone to monitor the performance in real time and illuminates the corresponding position of the fingerboard to improve accuracy; Interactive chord playing with built-in guitar, bass and drum accompaniment makes the practice more musical. Song Maker allows users to quickly build song structures, choose different styles of playback and export WAV files, while Songsheet Scanner uses computer vision to recognize printed chord scores and automatically save them to favorites. A daily chord, more than 20 alternative tunings, a menu bar shortcut metronome, and Apple Watch companion support keep your practice running through all-weather scenarios.

item.title: Tidyshot 2.7.3
item.description:
Smart Screenshot Auto Organizer

Tidyshot Screenshot Organizer is a screenshot management tool designed for Mac that sits quietly in the menu bar and monitors your screenshot folders in real time. When you capture a screen using the Mac's built-in snapshot tool or a third-party tool such as CleanShot or Shottr, Tidyshot automatically picks up the file in a few seconds, reads the text content on the screen through OCR technology, and intelligently generates a meaningful file name in combination with the name of the currently used application, such as changing the default timestamp file name to "figma-dashboard-header-component.png". At the same time, it moves files into a neat folder structure based on your settings, organized by source application, date, content type, or flattening so your desktop is no longer cluttered with cluttered screenshot files.

item.title: FletchShot 2.4.2
item.description:
macOS Screenshot Annotation OCR Tool

FletchShot is a screenshot annotation tool designed for macOS, aimed at those who need to quickly take screenshots, draw arrows, and share them instantly every day. As soon as you finish capturing, the annotation window opens immediately, and the arrow tool is selected. After drawing the arrow, grab the bottom edge label of the window and drag it directly into the Slack message Finder or Terminal, and it will be delivered as an image. You can also press Command+C to copy the content with annotations and paste it at any time. The entire process has no save dialog, no mode selection, and no export procedure. Scroll Capture allows you to scroll the target window yourself when long pages extend beyond the screen. The app stitches frames using ScreenCaptureKit, without the need for plugins, extensions, or accessibility permissions. Screen recording supports three modes: full screen, area, or window. Switch to click highlighting with one tap. The footer allows you to switch between MP4 and GIF formats and choose between high, medium, and low video quality. OCR runs on the device side based on Apple's Vision framework. It can extract error message tables, code, and even JSON on the screen as pastable text and automatically indent it. It prioritizes support for English and Japanese.

item.title: OnDevice OCR Pro 3.4.5
item.description:
Batch OCR tool for documents on macOS

OnDevice OCR Pro is an offline OCR and batch document processing tool for Mac that turns scans, images and PDFs into full-text searchable content. It runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud or subscription, so sensitive files stay local, which suits legal, medical, financial and office use. It can watch folders and process new documents automatically, with batch recognition, auto-rotation, image enhancement and smart skipping of already digital PDFs. Built-in multilingual OCR covers Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German and more, and it can extract text only to save disk space. It is well suited to invoices, receipts, contracts and research material.

item.title: Ember 1.6.12
item.description:
Private life diary software

Ember: Journal & Life Archive is a private logging tool that combines diary and interpersonal memory archives for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. When writing down daily, just mention a person in the text, and the relevant content will be gathered on the other person's personal page, gradually presenting the common experience, the time of acquaintance and the context of contact; You can also organize people by circles, such as home, work or campus, and use stories to record chapters of life that span many years. Dynamic retrospectives reimagine old memories on the right dates and gently remind you to keep an eye out for people you haven't been in touch with for a long time. The software provides calendars, maps, and people maps to help you navigate through life's snippets from dates, places, and networks, as well as support for searching text throughout your archives and photos. You can add photos, videos, voice memos, Apple Music songs, and weather, and import Day One, Apple Journal, and contacts. The diary is saved on the device and can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or password and synced privately via personal iCloud;

item.title: Reflow 26.9
item.description:
Multi Instrument Sheet Music Editor

Reflow is a powerful score and fingerprint editor designed for guitar, bass, drum, piano and many other musical instruments. It has been trusted by thousands of musicians around the world for more than ten consecutive years. It provides an intuitive visual keyboard input interface to support the fingerprint editing of string instruments (such as guitar, bass, banjo, ukulele) (including chord diagrams, bends, brushstrings and other effects), standard pentagram notation (including large spectral tables, cross-spectral wiring and other advanced functions). ), professional drum chromatography (supports tremolo, flam, drag, etc.), built-in high-quality Apple native rendering engine and synthesizer for instant playback, monorail/mute, loop segment, shifting exercise, real-time editing, core functions are completely free and watermark-free, subscribe to the premium version to permanently unlock watermark-free PDF export, 128 GM tones, multi-track music score display, metronome, playback speed control, MIDI keyboard input, etc., all data Local storage and support iCloud synchronization, no networking, no tracking, no account, compatible with Guitar Pro file reading and writing, MusicXML import, PDF export printing and cross-platform sharing (iPhone, iPad, Mac are available), carefully built by independent developers since 2011, dedicated to sound...

item.title: Balance 2.9
item.description:
Focus time tracker and timer

Balance is a time-tracking timer for Mac for study, work and freelancing. It combines focus timing, the Pomodoro technique, break reminders and hour logging so you start and stop tasks deliberately. You can track time per workspace and project, switch between regular timing and focus sessions, and log billable hours. It also provides a work-life balance score, log, month and year views, goals and exportable reports. It integrates with macOS through the menu bar, Spotlight, Shortcuts and Siri, with a clean interface.

item.title: Navicat Premium 18.0.6
item.description:
macOS Database Management Development Tools

Navicat Premium 18 is a macOS database tool for database development, management, modeling, and business intelligence analysis. It integrates AI assistance, SQL editing, data masking, data model design, BI dashboards, and bulk data processing capabilities. In the Data Editor and Table Designer, users can design table structures using natural language, automatically populate or translate field content, generate table comments, and quickly generate test data and data summaries. The SQL Editor offers features such as code insights, refactoring, real-time error detection, symbol renaming, reference highlighting, hover metadata, and go-to-definition, helping developers write and maintain complex queries more quickly. The Hybrid Model supports the unified management of conceptual models and physical structures, with naming conventions and glossaries that facilitate team collaboration and data governance. The BI module supports automatic layout, global parameters, page navigation, and automatic refresh. Batch editing, import wizards, Parquet file imports, personal configuration synchronization, and session history cover daily database operations and team workflows.

item.title: ElementNote 2.14.0
item.description:
Handwritten Notes and PDF Annotation Tools

Element Note is a handwriting note-taking, PDF annotation, and lightweight drawing app for macOS, iPadOS, and iOS, emphasizing a simple interface, a natural writing feel, and a high-quality rendering experience. It offers a variety of writing tools, including pencils, pens, ballpoint pens, art brushes, and markers. It also supports gradient ink, stroke smoothing, and Apple Pencil Pro's squeeze, haptic feedback, hover, and roll interactions, making classroom notes, study annotations, journal planning, and sketching feel more like using real paper and pen. The app allows you to insert text, shapes, stickers, and images. It supports practical features such as importing annotations from PDFs, batch exporting, lasso selection, moving content across pages, creating notes from photo albums, and more. With native OCR, you can search PDFs and handwritten content. Combined with tags, subfolders, folder colors, multi-select drag-and-drop, and page organization features, it is suitable for long-term management of a large number of notes. iCloud syncing and collaboration allow notes to be quickly updated across multiple devices and support collaborative editing by multiple users. The intelligent dark mode adjusts the reading environment according to the system appearance while maintaining consistency in the colors of the paper and handwriting.

item.title: FileZilla Pro RemoteDrive 1.8.0
item.description:
Mac Remote Disk Mounting Tool

FileZilla Pro RemoteDrive is a remote file and cloud storage management tool designed for Mac. It can mount FTP, FTPS, SFTP servers, and various cloud services as virtual disks in Finder via the Apple File Provider extension. After completing the connection configuration, users can browse directories, open files, move and rename items just like they would with a local hard drive or network drive. They can also work directly on remote files in editors or development tools, reducing the repetitive process of traditional downloading, modifying, and re-uploading. The software supports services such as Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, Azure, OpenStack Swift, etc., and also supports quick connection and management of multiple sites from the menu bar.

item.title: Session 2.13.50
item.description:
Mac Pomodoro Focus Timer

Session – The Pomodoro Focus Timer is a productivity tool for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that helps users enter a stable state of focus based on the Pomodoro Technique and time blocking. By setting focus periods and break periods, it reduces distractions during studying, writing, coding, and daily work, and reminds you to stop, record, and reflect at the end of each phase. On Mac, it supports blocking distracting websites and apps, muting Slack, and automatically enabling Do Not Disturb mode. It can also use AppleScript and Shortcuts to integrate the focus process into system-level automation. The app also provides categories, intentions, notes, statistical analysis, and progress reviews, making it easy for you to view your daily time allocation, task duration, and focus patterns. It also syncs conversations to Apple Calendar, making it suitable for long-term use by people who need to engage in deep work, develop habits, and practice self-management. Session – Pomodoro Focus Timer is a productivity tool that integrates focus timing, distraction blocking, automated linkage, and progress review. It is suitable for users who need to establish a consistent work rhythm on Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

item.title: HamHub 1.7.4
item.description:
Mac Net Drive with IPTV Video Player

HamHub – Your personal audio-visual expert is a multi-device home audio-visual management and playback macOS app that unifies cloud drives, media servers, and local/network resources into a single, clear repository that helps users organize scattered video files into a searchable, renewable, and synchronized private film and television center. It supports Alibaba Drive, Baidu Drive, Google Drive, WebDAV, SMB, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, IPTV, FTP/FTPS and other sources. It can also automatically identify movies, TV series, variety shows and other structures, and intelligently generate covers, details and episodes. The app has a built-in highly compatible player that supports 4K, Dolby Vision, HDR, Dolby Atmos, ISO Blu-ray Disc, multi-track and rich subtitle formats, and provides a picture-in-picture, continuous playback, gesture control, and speed-doubling viewing experience. Collections, viewing progress, and playback records sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV for users who want to efficiently manage their private library.

item.title: MsgFiler 4 4.3.3
item.description:
Powerful Apple Mail filtering and archiving tools

MsgFiler 4 is a keyboard-based email filing app for Apple Mail, designed to allow users to quickly filter their inbox list by typing and easily file selected emails. MsgFiler has been popular among Mac users since 2006, and the all-new MsgFiler 4 has been completely rewritten using Swift and SwiftUI to deliver a faster filing experience and support the latest systems, such as macOS 26 Tahoe. The software features an intelligent suggestion function that can predict and recommend suitable email addresses based on the user's filing history. It also supports quick filing to Gmail accounts, dark mode, and additional keyboard shortcuts. MsgFiler 4 offers a free mode and premium features, the latter of which can be accessed through a lifetime unlock, an annual membership, or a monthly subscription. With MsgFiler, users can significantly reduce the time spent processing emails, benefit from a dedicated filing environment, and boost productivity. There's no longer any need to rely on drag-and-drop operations to organize the inbox. MsgFiler 4 is a keyboard-based email filing application designed specifically for Apple Mail.

item.title: RocketSim 16.9.0
item.description:
Xcode Simulator Development Efficiency Enhancement Tool

RocketSim for Xcode Simulator is a macOS utility for iOS and iPadOS developers that enhances the everyday experience of using Xcode Simulator with side floating windows and menu bar capabilities. It integrates screenshots, screen recordings, GIF exports, device frames, touch trajectories, backgrounds, and metadata editing into a single workflow, making it easy to create App Store Connect preview assets and demo content. Developers can also limit network speed, disconnect from the network, view request responses, and copy summaries without installing a proxy certificate. They can also use Build Insights to observe changes in local build frequency and duration. The software provides tools such as universal links, push payloads, location routes, time zones, permissions, user defaults, camera simulation, design overlay, magnified color picking, and VoiceOver overlays. These tools reduce the need for frequent switching between settings, Finder, and Terminal, making the debugging, verification, and delivery of Swift, SwiftUI, and UIKit projects more seamless.

item.title: Shortery 10.0
item.description:
macOS Shortcut Enhancement Tool

Shortery is an application designed for macOS by German developer Lars Gerckens to enhance the automation capabilities of Apple Shortcuts. Although macOS Monterey offers Shortcuts, it lacks automation features similar to those on iOS. Shortery was created to address this issue. Users can set up various triggers through Shortery, such as app launch or exit, device connection or disconnection, changes in folder content, changes in focus mode, login and logout, etc., to automatically execute shortcuts. Users simply need to add shortcuts to Shortery, and they will run automatically under specific conditions, greatly simplifying daily workflows and enhancing ease of use. Shortery is a macOS app developed by German developer Lars Gerckens to enhance the automation capabilities of Apple Shortcuts. Although Apple offers Shortcuts on macOS Monterey, it does not include the "Shortcuts Automation" feature found on iOS. Shortery was developed to address this issue.

item.title: Irvue 2026.4
item.description:
Mac Wallpaper Auto-Changer

Irvue is a compact application that brings thousands of stunning high-resolution photos from Unsplash, allowing users to enjoy new artistic wallpapers on their desktops every day. The app is located in the menu bar and supports time settings for automatically changing wallpapers, including every 30 minutes, every hour, every 3 hours, every 12 hours, every 24 hours, every week, every two weeks, or every month. Users can customize keyboard shortcuts and enjoy compatibility with multi-monitor setups. The app offers a variety of channels, such as "Latest" and "Featured," for users to choose from. Users can download each photo to their Mac and automatically adjust the macOS theme based on the current wallpaper. Users with an Unsplash account can also like photos, create collections, and add photos to them. Irvue also offers the ability to hide photos and authors, and supports AppleScript, providing advanced users with more operational possibilities. Irvue is a wallpaper app from Unsplash that offers users thousands of stunning high-resolution photos designed to bring an artistic touch to their desktops. This compact application resides in the menu bar, allowing you to enjoy a new wallpaper every day.

item.title: BackupLoupe 3.15.4
item.description:
macOS Time Machine File Backup Management

BackupLoupe is a backup management and recovery tool for Time Machine that helps users quickly see which files have been backed up in each snapshot, which files take up the most space, and clearly distinguishes between large and small files with color-coded labels. It supports quick searches by name, path, size, and file type, allowing you to directly locate the target file and restore it via drag-and-drop or the right-click menu. You can also view the file's initial backup, version changes, and deletion records, making it easy to trace backup history. Even if Time Machine cannot recognize old backups or cannot restore specific items, BackupLoupe can provide additional recovery options. The software also integrates Finder operations and supports the management of multiple hosts and backup disks. It allows users to view backup distribution and coverage periods, and combines existing backup data to estimate backup growth and changes in remaining disk space. It is suitable for macOS users who need to frequently organize, troubleshoot, and retrieve Time Machine backup content.

item.title: TelunKey 2.1.19
item.description:
Mac Window Switcher

TelunKey is a native macOS keyboard window switching tool developed with Swift that integrates application activation and target window selection into a single keystroke operation for work scenarios that frequently switch between multiple applications, windows, and desktops. The software supports independent triggering of left and right Command and left and right Option, and can also be triggered using Space, which is convenient to configure the operation according to personal habits. After triggering, the actionable target is directly displayed, and the window keyboard layout is mapped to the key position area. The user can confirm the target by pressing the key, reducing the repeated switching between the application and the mouse to find the window. Especially suitable for Chrome multi-window browsing and the scene where a large number of windows work in parallel. TelunKey focuses on low latency response and lightweight background operation, reducing double counting and invalid wake-up by updating window information on demand and lightweight cache. Core data remains on-premises, with no behavioral analysis by default, and no reliance on cloud services. The software supports at least macOS 14.0 Sonoma, which can be installed and updated through Homebrew, and in-app check for updates;

item.title: NotchPad 2.2.2
item.description:
Liuhai Area Quick Note Tool

NotchPad is a Mac Security Notepad app designed for MacBook Liu Haiping that cleverly integrates notepads, clipboard history, and reusable snippets into the MacBook's Liuhai area, providing quick access with just a mouse hover without switching windows or interrupting current workflows. NotchPad supports rich text editing features, including bold, italics, lists, and other formats, so users can easily pin important notes to the top and quickly find what they need with an instant search. The app enables encryption protection by default, and all data is stored locally on your Mac and never sent to any server for privacy. NotchPad syncs with Apple Notes in both directions. Users can browse and edit Apple Notes in-app, and the changes are instantly returned to the native Notes app. It also supports more than 50 file types, including txt, Markdown, RTF, Word, PDF, and various code files such as Swift, Python, JavaScript, etc. After importing, it will retain a rich text format.

item.title: Tuna 0.113
item.description:
macOS Native Modernization Launcher

Tuna is a new modern launcher for macOS, redesigned based on the classic interactive concept of Quicksilver and built from the ground up using native Swift, with an emphasis on speed, keyboard drives, and a stereotyped operating experience. It is suitable for macOS 15 Sequoia or update system. It provides a variety of input and execution methods such as Fuzzy Mode, Combo Mode, Text Mode and Talk Mode. Users can quickly locate applications, files or actions through fuzzy search, and can also complete more complex workflows with combined instructions. Tuna supports extension mechanisms and plans to introduce third-party extension capabilities that will allow the launcher to be used not only to open applications, but also to gradually assume the role of an entry point for automation, text processing, command triggering, and day-to-day efficiency. The overall interface is modern macOS style, suitable for Mac users who want to use the keyboard to reduce mouse operation, improve system navigation efficiency, and find the spiritual successor of Quicksilver.

item.title: Glyphs 4 4.2
item.description:
Professional font design tools

Glyphs 4 is a professional font editor for macOS for font designers, glyph engineers, brand designers, icon makers, and those looking to learn font design. The software provides an intuitive and efficient drawing environment for precise editing of Bézier curves, nodes, stroke thicknesses, endpoints, and corners, as well as support for batch curvature adjustment, balance handles, and coordination curve segments. Through the multi-master font and interpolation function, users can manage complex font families, quickly generate static fonts and variable fonts; the component system can reuse glyphs, anchors, and icon shapes, so that modifications can be applied to related characters simultaneously. Glyphs 4 supports visual spacing adjustment, contextual even spacing, OpenType features, real-time text preview, and multiple color font formats to directly check long text, word weight changes, and typography effects. The software also integrates Python 3 script editing and debugging, plugin manager, glyph batch processing, master browsing and rich export capabilities, supports CFF, CFF2, TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, PNG, SVG, PDF and SF Symbols and other formats, covering the entire process from sketching, glyph production to font publishing.

item.title: Multitouch 2.1.1
item.description:
macOS trackpad gesture control enhancement

Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add gestures to macOS, with support for a well-designed trackpad and magic mouse gestures, and a plethora of options for browsers, keyboard shortcuts, and click actions. The software has built-in best-in-class window management features, including Rectangle's keyboard shortcuts, menu items, and drag-and-drop alignment areas. In addition, users can convert a key to a superkey, click with a key, remap a button, or create a shortcut to execute a script. Multitouch supports the use of any trackpad or magic mouse on macOS 10.15 and above, and each license can be activated simultaneously on up to three devices. Multitouch is a powerful gesture engine designed to easily add multi-touch gestures to macOS with a well-designed trackpad and Magic Mouse gestures. The software provides rich operation options, including browser operations, keystrokes, mouse clicks, etc., to help users achieve efficient workflows.

item.title: Bloom 1.5.50
item.description:
Increase efficiency with multi-pane file management

Bloom is a productivity-enhancing alternative to Finder designed to provide users with a more streamlined and efficient file management experience. It has a number of powerful features, including a system-wide "Go to Folder" shortcut and keyword search capabilities, allowing users to quickly locate the files they need. Bloom's Portal window is designed to be compact and easy to use in multitasking, while allowing you to view the contents of a compressed file without decompressing it. The app also offers a variety of useful tools, including intelligent column width auto-adjustment, advanced renaming capabilities, iCloud Drive support, and easy folder manipulation. Bloom Mac is an improved Finder alternative designed to enhance user productivity and file management experience with powerful features and multi-pane layouts. It provides an intuitive way to search and manipulate files, enabling users to organize and access files more efficiently. Multi-pane layout: Bloom supports multi-pane layout, users can view and manage multiple folders at the same time, improve productivity. Quick search experience: With the shortcut ⌘ aves, users can quickly access the⇧ "Go to folder" function, which supports searching for files by keywords, and the search speed is extremely fast.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.44
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.
